courses.title: THEORY MEETS PRACTICE: CAREERS & COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT SEMINAR
courses.prereqText: Registration in the second, third, or fourth year of either a Major or Honours Specialization module within the Faculty of Information and Media Studies, with a cumulative average of at least 70%, no failures in FIMS courses, no more than 1.0 failure in a non-FIMS course, and no documented academic offenses. Priority will be given to students registered in the FIMS Internship module.

courses.title: INTERNSHIP
courses.prereqText: FIMS 2999A/B/Y. Approval of, and acceptance into, the Faculty of Information and Media Studies Internship Module.

courses.title: INTERNSHIP PLACEMENT TERM
courses.prereqText: Completion of FIMS 2999A/B/Y and enrolment in FIMS 3990A/B/Y. Approval of, and acceptance into, the FIMS Internship Module. Registration in the third or fourth year of either a Major or Honours Specialization module within the Faculty of Information and Media Studies, completion of all second-year FIMS required courses and at least 10.0 courses with a cumulative average of at least 70%, no failures in FIMS courses, no more than 1.0 failure in a non-FIMS course, and no documented academic offenses.
